[ -f .env ] && . ./.env

  echo "deploy: DEPLOY_TOKEN is not set" >&2

echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) dry-run ok: target=$DEPLOY_TARGET token=****$last4" >> deploy.log
echo "dry run ok (token ****$last4)"
